policy: CampaignPolicy + preferred reward/shop theme + rest/develop camps v2
scope: No capture, rare hunts or stat/resource overrides. Rest preserves the original camp policy. Develop resolves encounters, purchases usable evolution items with a 100-gold reserve, rests below 75% HP or for friendship, otherwise upgrades; it removes low-rated or duplicate non-damaging techniques. Combat and learning policy stay the same.
